meanings: to sing, to call loudly, to chant
surname Che, car, vehicle, machine, to shape with a lathe, Kangxi radical 159, war chariot (archaic), rook (in Chinese chess), rook (in chess)
to eat; to consume, to eat at (a cafeteria etc), to eradicate; to destroy, to absorb, to suffer (shock, injury, defeat etc), variant of 吃
to have a meal, to eat, to make a living

to go out, to come out, to occur, to produce, to go beyond, to rise, to put forth, to happen, (used after a verb to indicate an outward direction or a positive result), classifier for dramas, plays, operas etc, variant of 出 (classifier for plays or chapters of classical novels)
to come out, to appear, to arise, (after a verb, indicates coming out, completion of an action, or ability to discern or detect)
